name: Soracom Query
description: Soracom Query helps users inspect the available data schema, check query usage, run SQL across JP or Global coverage, analyze bounded results, and download complete query exports.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Soracom Query to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Soracom Query to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://query.soracom.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Soracom Query MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Soracom Query provides these MCP tools: get_query_export, get_query_result, get_query_schema, get_query_usage, and start_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Soracom Query?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Soracom Query in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Soracom Query MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Soracom Query requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Soracom Query is developed by SORACOM, INC.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
